collection.title: Chevrolet Camaro 2011 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Chevrolet Camaro 2011 to 2015 requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
